subject.title: fix: guard JSON.parse calls against malformed external responses

question: Should this PR remain the canonical broad JSON.parse guard while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101488 is rebased around it, or should this PR be narrowed/split before merge?
rationale: The code change is narrow and correct, but another active OpenRouter PR edits the same stream reader for a different safety fix, so automation should not choose the branch sequencing alone.

options.title: Keep This As The Parse Guard
options.body: Merge this broad guard after normal maintainer review, then require the stream-cap PR to rebase while preserving the malformed-frame skip.

options.title: Split The OpenRouter Hunk
options.body: If maintainers want the stream-cap PR to own all OpenRouter edits first, narrow this PR to the docs search and Claude MCP config fixes.

options.title: Rebase This PR After Stream Caps
options.body: Pause this PR until the stream-cap branch lands, then rebase the malformed-frame guard onto the updated OpenRouter reader.

recommendation.title: Keep This As The Parse Guard
recommendation.body: Merge this broad guard after normal maintainer review, then require the stream-cap PR to rebase while preserving the malformed-frame skip.
